protocol.name: TEV Protease Cleavage of Fusion Protein
protocol.purpose: Remove an affinity or solubility tag from a fusion protein using TEV protease.

steps.text: Exchange the fusion protein into cleavage buffer using {{ph:1774024712936-7dba43a18d95f8}}.
Add TEV protease at an enzyme-to-substrate ratio of {{ph:1774024712936-8060b8a60ca3b}}.
Remove an aliquot before and after cleavage for SDS-PAGE analysis.
Separate the cleaved tag, uncleaved protein, and TEV protease using {{ph:1774024712936-e83fc6a9af4a2}}.

protocol.troubleshooting:
Problem: Incomplete cleavage; Possible cause: Insufficient TEV amount or inaccessible cleavage site; Solution: Increase incubation time, increase TEV ratio, or optimize buffer composition
Problem: Protein precipitates during cleavage; Possible cause: Protein is unstable in cleavage buffer; Solution: Test alternative salt concentration, glycerol level, or lower protein concentration
